query: read-it-later app that automatically categorizes saved web articles and sends a daily digest resurfacing unread items, synced across phone and laptop, for personal use

fingerprint.desiredOutcome: saved links land already sorted into categories, with a daily nudge that picks a few unread items to read
fingerprint.operatingMode: hosted service plus mobile and desktop/laptop apps; personal use; non-programmer; cloud reading of links acceptable
